title: Static Variables for State Retention in Button Debouncing
description:
Local variables declared with `static` retain their values between function calls throughout program execution.

This encapsulates driver state locally inside the function instead of exposing messy global variables across the codebase.

### Requirements:
Implement a 3-sample integrator debouncer: When `raw_sample` matches `last_sample` for 3 consecutive calls, update `debounced_state`.
hint: `static` inside a function gives variable permanent lifetime while restricting its scope to that function.
